# Spiff

> Spiff is a commission automation and sales compensation platform that helps finance and sales teams design, manage, and optimize commission structures with real-time visibility and compliance.

Spiff provides commission management solutions for enterprises, integrating with CRM, ERP, and HCM systems to automate commission calculations, ensure compliance with ASC 606 and IFRS 15 standards, and deliver real-time commission insights that drive sales performance. The platform serves finance teams seeking payroll automation and sales leaders focused on motivation and retention.

## Key Topics

- Commission automation
- Sales compensation design
- Real-time commission tracking
- Commission accounting (ASC 606, IFRS 15)
- Finance and payroll compliance
- Sales motivation and retention
- CRM/ERP/HCM integrations
- Sales turnover cost reduction
- AI considerations for finance
- Commission analytics (Looker)
- Sales performance management
- Revenue operations
- Commission plan design
